parent_control: V19 retained L40S stock-vLLM AWQ BF16 activation arm
causal_hypothesis: vLLM warns that BF16 Marlin on pre-SM90 can underperform FP16. Changing only activation dtype from bfloat16 to float16 on the same L40S, image, checkpoint, runtime, and workloads may improve c1/c8 throughput while preserving paired quality.
candidate_change: Set only vLLM --dtype float16 instead of bfloat16. Keep compressed-tensors checkpoint bytes and all other server flags fixed.
expected_direction: At least 5% c8 throughput improvement would make the dtype change operationally useful; a smaller change is treated as neutral. Any paired quality regression, geometry/SLO failure, or c8 below V19 rejects the change.

workload.semantic: two exact temperature-zero alpha/beta JSON requests
workload.c1: 4 requests, concurrency 1, exact 8192 input and 1024 output tokens
workload.c8: 16 requests, concurrency 8, exact 8192 input and 1024 output tokens

hardware_and_resident_state.session_watchdog: original absolute-deadline cleanup watchdog remains active

artifact_contract: Distinct local V20 directory; hash-matched archive and internal manifest; model/runtime/dtype/server identity; semantic, paired quality/NLL, c1/c8 rows, metrics, telemetry, conditional trace; retain only if next arm starts within ten minutes; final owner deletes instance/disk and verifies zero.
stop_rules: Semantic failure stops. Valid quality failure suppresses trace but not fixed performance. Any harness error opens a ten-minute in-place repair window. Do not repeat unchanged.
